title: Scenario 9: Large Data Uploads
description: After collecting sensitive data, APT29 exfiltrates it to external servers. Look for large outbound data transfers, especially to file-sharing or paste sites.
hunt_for: Large HTTP POST requests or uploads to external IPs. Focus on connections to file-sharing services, paste sites, or cloud storage with unusual data volumes.
kibana_query: method:POST AND (uri:*/upload* OR uri:*/api* OR host:*pastebin* OR host:*file-share*)
detection_tips: Calculate upload sizes from HTTP POST requests
Correlate with previous file access events
key_indicators: Uploads to paste sites or file shares
